description:
Change a broadcast: end its live run (onAir false), or its settings: its name, who can listen (public, or private behind a listener code VocalStack makes), the language spoken, and whether translations are read aloud, in stock or the speakers' own cloned voices; or bring it back from the trash.
Use: to end the event when it is over (onAir false), or before or between runs to change settings; settings apply from the next start_broadcast, the name and access at once. Only the fields given change; give at least one. Starting a run: start_broadcast; removing the broadcast and its link: delete_broadcast.
Arguments: broadcastId (required); the rest are independent and optional, except that newListenerCode goes only with a private broadcast and clonedVoices only with spokenTranslations on, needing consent true. No code is ever passed in: VocalStack makes it, so it never sits in the model's arguments. restore true brings a deleted broadcast back first, then applies the rest. Examples: {broadcastId, onAir: false} (ends the run); {broadcastId, access: "private"} (returns listenerCode); {broadcastId, newListenerCode: true}; {broadcastId, spokenTranslations: true, clonedVoices: true, consent: true}; {broadcastId, restore: true}.
Behaviour: the link and broadcastId never change; no call here makes a new address (for one: delete_broadcast, then start_broadcast without broadcastId). Changing access or the listener code signs out every current listener at once, even on air: their page asks for the link again (and the code when private), and they miss the lines spoken until they are back; the transcript is kept. Making it public again lets anyone with the link in, with no sign-in. The name shows to listeners at once; language and voice settings never touch a run in progress. Ending a run (onAir false) is free and final for that run: billing stops at that moment, listeners see the broadcast is over, and the transcript is kept (get_transcription reads it and its summary once done); it cannot be resumed, but start_broadcast with this broadcastId and a streamUrl starts a new run on the same link, as a new transcription. Asking again when already off air changes nothing. Not idempotent as a whole, as annotated: newListenerCode true makes a different code on every call (each one signing listeners out again); every other field repeated with the same value changes nothing. Two calls at once: the later one wins, field by field. A read-only key is refused before anything changes. restore works for 30 days after delete_broadcast; after that it is not_found. Gives rate_limited (with retryAfterS) past 600 calls a minute per API key.
Returns: the broadcast (broadcastId, name, link, access, onAir, listenersNow) with spokenLanguage, spokenTranslations and clonedVoices; with onAir false, stopped: the ended run's status (transcriptionId, name, kind live, state finishing then done, startedAt, endedAt, durationS), null when it was not on air; restored with restore; listenerCode only on the call that made it (going private the first time, or newListenerCode), never again, so pass it on to the listeners then.
Errors: invalid_options for nothing to change, onAir true, a bad name, newListenerCode on a public broadcast, an unknown language, restore false, or clonedVoices true without consent; invalid_state for a broadcast in the trash without restore true; not_found for an unknown broadcastId; forbidden for a key without the write and recordings:publish scopes.

access.description: public: anyone with the link can follow it; private: listeners must enter the broadcast's listener code, which VocalStack makes the first time it goes private and returns once as listenerCode.

broadcastId.description: A broadcastId from list_broadcasts or start_broadcast.

clonedVoices.description: With spokenTranslations: true reads each speaker's translated words in that speaker's own cloned voice (needs consent true); false: stock voices.

consent.description: Must be true with clonedVoices true: confirms everyone speaking on it agreed to have their voice cloned. Recorded with your account and the time. Not needed to turn cloned voices off.

name.description: New name shown to listeners; trimmed, 1 to 120 characters.

newListenerCode.description: true: VocalStack makes a new listener code for a private broadcast and returns it once as listenerCode, signing out every current listener (share the new one with them). The old code stops working at once. Not accepted with access public.

onAir.description: false: end the live run now, which stops its billing; the transcript is kept and the link stays for the next start_broadcast. Already off air: nothing changes. true is not accepted: start_broadcast puts a broadcast on air.

restore.description: true: bring it back from the trash (after delete_broadcast, within the restore window) with its link, settings and recorded transcriptions; other fields given apply after. false is not accepted.

spokenLanguage.description: Code of the language spoken (e.g. en, es), or auto to detect it. Applies from the next start_broadcast.

spokenTranslations.description: true: each translation is also read aloud, so listeners can hear it in their language; false: text only. Applies from the next start_broadcast. Listening stays free.

name: update_broadcast
title: Update a broadcast
